props.name: value
props.description: Single selection: the selected value, null for none.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Any number of values may be selected; they are then `values`, `defaultValues` and `onValuesChange`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called after the browser or a part opened or closed it. A press outside and Escape can't be refused: a controlled select that keeps `open` true is shown again.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The popup can be opened and browsed, but nothing can be selected.

props.name: name
props.description: With a name (or inside a named FieldRoot) the select submits its value with a <form>; with `multiple`, one entry per selected value.

props.name: items
props.description: The label of each value, when it must be known before its item has rendered, or differs from the item's text.

parts.name: SelectTrigger
parts.description: Spread on a <button>: `popovertarget` makes the browser open and close the popup on a click, Enter and Space, and anchor the popup to it. The arrow keys open it through the select, and typing on the closed trigger selects.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: SelectValue
parts.description: The selected item's label (labels joined by ", " when `multiple`), or the placeholder.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is selected (the value then carries `data-placeholder`).

parts.name: SelectIcon
parts.description: A decoration beside the value (a chevron), hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: SelectPopup
parts.description: The items stay in the document while it is closed: they name the selected value and answer typeahead on the closed trigger.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and popup, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

props.name: label
props.description: The text that names the value, in SelectValue and for typeahead.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present on the item that has the highlight.

parts.name: SelectItemText
parts.description: The item's text: what SelectValue shows for it, when the item holds more than its label (an indicator).

parts.name: SelectItemIndicator
parts.description: Shown while its item is selected, unless `keepMounted`.

parts.name: SelectArrow
parts.description: Spread on an element inside the popup: it is placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger, and carries the popup's `data-side`. The shape (a rotated square, an SVG) is the stylesheet's.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.
